notes: There are 24 items in the D.D. BOX. The player can exchange 5 D.D. Orbs for 1 random item from the BOX, also the player can reset the box at any time. In addition, Gems were also added on the D.D. Box.
After the conclusion of the event, the LP Potions are replaced by 1000 Gold each; the LP Potions (Small) are replaced by 200 Gold each; while the D.D. Draw items are replaced by 500 Gold each.
